function.description: Retrieve the name of the discoverer of an element based on its name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: Optional parameter that refers to the year of discovery. It could be helpful in case an element was discovered more than once. Default to 0, which means not use it.

first.description: Optional parameter indicating if the first discoverer's name should be retrieved.
